messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"chapter":37,"source_ref":"37:1","text":"Then Seth and his mother went off towards the gates of paradise. And while they were walking, lo! suddenly there came a beast"},{"chapter":37,"source_ref":"37:2","text":"[a serpent] and attacked and bit Seth. And as soon as Eve saw it, she wept and said: 'Alas, wretched woman that I am. I am accursed since I have not kept the commandment of God.'"},{"chapter":37,"source_ref":"37:3","text":"And Eve said to the serpent in a loud voice: 'Accursed beast! how (is it that) thou hast not feared to let thyself loose against the image of God, but hast dared to fight with it'"},{"chapter":38,"source_ref":"38:1","text":"The beast answered in the language of men: 'Is it not against you, Eve, that our malice (is directed) Are not ye the objects of our rage"},{"chapter":38,"source_ref":"38:2","text":"Tell me, Eve, how was thy mouth opened to eat of the fruit But now if I shall begin to reprove thee thou canst not bear it.'"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 37:1, 37:2, 37:3, 38:1, 38:2.
